$comment: Strategy A: Playwright keeps launching/owning Chrome (persistent profile, channel chrome),
and Playwright's chromium launcher appends --remote-debugging-pipe as it always does.
These extra launch args add a TCP CDP endpoint on the SAME Chrome process so a second
DevTools-protocol client (the DSH browser pane) can attach without disturbing Playwright.
--remote-allow-origins=* is required for WebSocket CDP clients that send an Origin header
Merged by @playwright/mcp via mergeConfig(): config-file launchOptions survive CLI options.
